Maya (Finance): Heads up — Novus Labs sent invoice INV-2026-0892 referencing an old PO (PO-2018-009) that was closed in 2019. Amount $12,450. We don't have an approver on file (Riley left last year). Attachment uploaded below.

invoicobot: PDF uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0892.pdf (size: 342KB) :page_facing_up:

Lina (AP): Putting this on hold until we get a PO match or a retro PO. OCR picked up a weird PO string — says "PO: 0-000". Can procurement confirm?

Arjun (Procure): That PO number rings a bell — looks like legacy contract work. @Jared (Vendor Ops) do you know if Novus had any renewals or an SOW that would cover this charge? If not, we need a retro PO or vendor credit.

Jared (Vendor Ops): Checking with Novus rep now. Vendor says invoice is for a hardware replacement from SOW 2018-12. I'm asking them to send the SOW scan and the original ticket. Will share when I have it.

Maya (Finance): Quick metadata for the record:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0892
Vendor: Novus Labs (vendor_id NL-482)
Amount: $12,450.00
Invoice date: 2026-03-15
PO referenced: PO-2018-009
Attachment: https://files.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0892.pdf
```

Arjun (Procure): If they produce the SOW that ties to the work, we can create a one-time retro PO and route approvals to legacy-approvers@redwood.com. @Maya do you want me to open the request?

Maya (Finance): Yes please. Tag cost center ENG-PLAT and label expense "legacy-hardware". Lina — is GL 5801 appropriate?

Lina (AP): GL 5801 (Contracts) works. I'm setting invoice status to on-hold. /hold-invoice INV-2026-0892

invoicobot: Invoice INV-2026-0892 status changed to ON_HOLD by Lina (AP) at 2026-03-18T14:27:00Z

Jared (Vendor Ops): Novus rep just sent SOW scan and internal ticket ID. Uploading now: https://files.redwood.com/vendor_docs/novus_sow_2018-12.pdf

Arjun (Procure): I'll open a retro PO request. Need a short justification in the JIRA — Maya can you paste a 1-2 line justification for the procurement ticket?

Maya (Finance): Sure — "Invoice corresponds to hardware replacement under SOW 2018-12 executed during legacy procurement window; vendor invoiced post-contract-close. Request retro PO to clear outstanding vendor invoice and maintain GL continuity."

Arjun (Procure): Opened JIRA INF-3421: Retro PO request for Novus invoice. Link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-3421 — assigned to procurement-legacy team. ETA: 2 business days.

Maya (Finance): Thanks. Once INF-3421 is approved, AP can match and pay. If procurement can't approve by EOD Friday, we'll ask Novus for a vendor-issued credit to avoid aging.

Lina (AP): Noted. If we don't get a PO by Fri EOD, I'll request vendor credit and block payment.

Jared (Vendor Ops): Novus confirmed their bank details and SOW match. They said they'll accept a retro PO or issue a credit. They're fine waiting 48 hours for the PO.

Maya (Finance): Great — keeping this thread as the single source. I'll update the payment queue when INF-3421 lands. :thumbsup:

Arjun (Procure): Will ping legacy-approvers email and expedite.

Lina (AP): Closing the loop here once PO exists. Thanks everyone.
